content.text: You’re a digital creator in Nigeria. You’ve designed a premium font pack. You price it at $97. You try to sell it. Stripe blocks you. PayPal isn’t available. Gumroad takes 10%. This isn’t a local [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-how-solve|The Problem]]—it’s a global lockout. The solution isn’t a workaround. It’s infrastructure. This post breaks down the exact [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-6|architecture]] to sell design assets, ebooks, courses, or templates with crypto payments. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership. Built for regions where conventional payment processors are restricted or unavailable.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is a sovereign commerce stack—a complete combination of tools that let you sell digital products directly to buyers, anywhere. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS product. It’s infrastructure you own. The core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each piece is selected for reliability, cost, and independence. For example, instead of Gumroad’s 10% fee, NOWPayments charges 0.5% for crypto transactions. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more. This isn’t about avoiding fees—it’s about building a system no single platform can shut down.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting—both are free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on complexity. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Product files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and verifies transactions on-chain. When a buyer sends payment, a webhook triggers the delivery script. The system is stateless: no buyer data is stored permanently. You own the code. You control the flow. The buyer gets the product instantly—no accounts required.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this stack gives you a fully operational store. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. With this setup, you’re not dependent on any platform. No subscriptions. No shutdown risks. You deploy once, own forever. It’s pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are realities, not hypotheticals.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—compared to Gumroad’s 10%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, like order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store product files. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, converting USD prices to the chosen cryptocurrency at transaction time. The system is modular: swap components as needed. For example, if you outgrow Google Sheets, migrate to Supabase without rebuilding the stack. Each component is chosen for its cost, reliability, and independence from third-party control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Both are deployed in 48 hours. If you prefer to build yourself, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197)—all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, instantly downloadable. Each blueprint includes full source code, deployment guides, and scaling playbooks. Deploy on your own domain. Load your products. Start selling. The infrastructure is yours from day one. No platform fees. No buyer accounts. Just direct, sovereign commerce.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup bypasses platform restrictions and fees. For example, if you sell a $97 ebook 100 times per month, you retain $921 more than with Gumroad’s 10% fee. The system is automated: buyers pay in crypto, and the ebook is delivered instantly via a secure link. You own the infrastructure—no platform can shut it down.
The stack is stateless: no buyer data is stored permanently. Full compliance with privacy regulations by default.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or need a digital download store with no platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to deploy your stack. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit is for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. Whether you’re selling fonts, courses, or software, the architecture is the same—sovereign, scalable, and platform-independent.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure file delivery works. Deploy to your domain. Load your products. Announce your store. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments dashboard. Scale by adding more products or upgrading components as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you in 48 hours. If you prefer to build, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step guides and templates. No coding required for basic setups.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks—transaction fees are under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but these networks are optimized for low-cost transactions.
Do buyers need a crypto wallet to purchase?

Yes, but they don’t need an account with you. NOWPayments handles the transaction directly. Buyers send payment from their wallet, and the product is delivered automatically once the payment confirms on-chain.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?
Crypto transactions are irreversible, so refunds are handled manually. Clearly state your refund policy on your storefront. For chargebacks, since crypto payments are final, this is not a concern.
Can I scale this stack as my sales grow?

Yes. The architecture is modular. Upgrade from Google Sheets to Supabase for order storage, or from Google Drive to Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook.
You own the infrastructure. No platform can shut you down. Deploy once, sell forever.
Complete Builder Kit — $197. All 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately.
